post.summary:
DM / group-DM calls. StartDMCall is the caller-initiated action;
JoinDMCall is the callee accepting. Both return a LiveKit token.

put.summary: Pin/unpin via PUT/DELETE on the /pin sub-resource (idempotent).

Per-channel allow/deny permission overrides. Layered on top of the
guild-level role permissions — Discord precedence rules apply
(user beats role, deny beats allow within a layer for user, allow
beats deny within a layer for role; owner and ADMINISTRATOR bypass).

Self-state toggles. PUT = flag on (mute/deaf/video/screen), DELETE = off.
Returns updated participant list so callers can refresh UI in one round trip.

Moderator-level ops: act on a specific participant. PUT body carries
the boolean because the action is "set muted=true/false", not strictly
idempotent toggle (admin may force-mute regardless of current state).

post.summary: DM channels live under /v1/dms (no parent guild).

Guild channels are nested under /v1/guilds/{guild_id}/channels so the
URL reflects the parent → child relationship. Single-resource ops
(GET / PATCH / DELETE) go through /v1/channels/{channel_id} because
a channel id is already globally unique.

put.summary:
Deprecated: per-user guild grants. REST mapping returns 501 in the
handler; kept here so old client SDKs compile. Prefer role-based
grants below or channel overrides in ChannelService.
Idempotent "make X the owner"; PUT on the /owner sub-resource.

Role-scoped permission grants (Discord's primary model — a role
carries a permission set, every assigned user inherits).

get.summary: Public (bypasses auth interceptor) — GET on the invite resource.

Bulk reader takes user_ids as repeated query params (?user_ids=a&user_ids=b).
Kept GET even with a list because the operation is a pure fan-out read.

post.summary: Convenience: auto-resolve/create DM channel by recipient and post.

v1DMMember.description:
DMMember is a lightweight user profile embedded in DM channel responses so
clients don't need a second round trip to UserService to render the list.

bannerUrl.description: Guild banner URL on "update" banner change.

roleName.description:
Role snapshot — populated on ROLE_CREATE, ROLE_UPDATE, ROLE_DELETE,
and on the ROLE_UPDATE events emitted by GrantRolePermission /
RevokeRolePermission. Carrying the full role state in the event
lets clients refresh their cache atomically without a follow-up
ListRolePermissions round trip.

v1Permission.title:
- PERMISSION_VIEW_AUDIT_LOG: Guild-wide additions
 - PERMISSION_MODERATE_MEMBERS: timeout
 - PERMISSION_SEND_TTS_MESSAGES: Channel / voice / text additions
 - PERMISSION_CREATE_PUBLIC_THREADS: Threads + events

targetUsername.description: Full handle of the user to friend-request, e.g. "alice#1234".
